name: sdoc-lexica
description: Read, write and navigate SDOC files and Lexica knowledge trees: skills for the format, read-only tools that outline, read and search files by section, and hooks that show each file's reading and editing guides and check every edit.

verbose.title: Verbose
verbose.description: Show a line in the session for everything the plugin does: the index it attaches, the guides it adds after a Read, an edit it refuses, the findings it reports, each tool call. Claude is not sent these lines. Off, they go to the debug log only (claude --debug-file).

indexSize.title: Knowledge index size
indexSize.description: The most the lexica/ index may add to a conversation's first prompt: 6k, 12k or 24k characters (about 1,500, 3,000 or 6,000 tokens). When the summaries do not fit, every file is listed with its title instead.
